mainEntity.name: What is Crypto Twitter KOL marketing and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crypto Twitter KOL marketing is the practice of engaging key opinion leaders on X to create authentic posts about your protocol, token or product, coordinated in timed waves across creator tiers. It is best suited to Web3 projects preparing for a token launch, TGE, mainnet or major partnership reveal, where community momentum on X feeds into press coverage and AI-engine citations. Shilika Jain has run coordinated KOL waves for 50+ Web3 and AI protocols.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Crypto Twitter KOL campaign cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Creator fees by tier: nano ($200–$1.5K per post), micro ($500–$5K), mid-tier ($10K–$30K), macro ($25K–$100K+). A typical launch wave across 10–20 mixed-tier creators runs $15K–$40K in creator fees. mainEntity.name: How do you handle disclosure and compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every campaign brief includes correct #ad or #sponsored disclosure language from day one. All creator contracts reference the disclosure requirement, and posts are checked before they go live. The SEC and FTC have both pursued enforcement actions against crypto KOL campaigns that lacked proper disclosure. Disclosure does not kill engagement; a credibly disclosed post from a trusted creator outperforms an undisclosed one the moment scrutiny arrives.
